verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform like Vanta, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out for Vanta's own product. The GDPR 'privacy workflows' material describes helping customers run their own compliance programs, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
